profile_text: Cloud-based learning and human capital management software solutions are the specialty of this German-based firm, which caters to businesses seeking to enhance their employee development and management capabilities. With a focus on scalable solutions, the company has established itself as a key player in the industry, although it has experienced a decline in employee count, down 39.9% since its baseline. As a scaler, it continues to adapt and refine its offerings to meet the evolving needs of its clients.
